Dear candidate,

Thank you for your application for the ML Engineer position. We will not move forward with your application, because your CV does not show this required point: experience with ML in production (3+ years of training, testing, deployment, and monitoring of real-time models).

Additionally, your CV does not show experience with microservices architecture, cloud technologies, Docker, and Kubernetes.

This decision was prepared with an automated system. You have the right to request a human review of this decision (GDPR Art. 22): simply reply to this message.

Kind regards
